jobs.occupation: Logistics Employee Reach Truck at DHL Bemmel (121134003)
jobs.description:
Will you be driving a reach truck at DHL in Bemmel soon?

Would you like to start in logistics and develop yourself into a reach truck driver? At our new DHL Supply Chain location in Bemmel, we are looking for logistics employees who want to work with a reach truck.

No certificate yet? No problem: DHL will train you internally to become a reach truck driver – fully on the job and at our expense.

What will you do?

- Operating a reach truck to store and retrieve goods, including at height
- Moving pallets and goods throughout the warehouse
- Picking and scanning orders
- Processing incoming and outgoing goods
- Ensuring a clean, safe, and organized workplace

You will work at a location that is continuously developing, where new clients are regularly being onboarded. This means you will constantly learn new processes.

Good to know: working hours

In July, August, and September, we operate three shifts to handle the busy period:

- 06:00 – 15:00
- 08:00 – 17:00
- 15:00 – 24:00

From October onwards, you will switch to regular day shifts (Monday to Friday between 07:00 and 18:00). Your weekends will be free.

Due to the early and late shifts during the first months, own transportation is recommended.

Who are you?

- You are at least 18 years old
- You are eager to learn and want to develop into a reach truck driver
- You work accurately and with a focus on safety
- You are available for 32 to 40 hours per week in day shifts, Monday to Friday between 07:00 and 18:00
- You speak Dutch or English

A reach truck certificate is a plus, but not required, we value motivation and commitment more, and we will provide your internal training at DHL.

Once you’ve mastered your own process, you’ll have the opportunity to move on to the next department within production!

Your main tasks will include:

- Assembling materials using hand tools
- Reading technical drawings
- Performing quality checks
- Communicating with the machining department
- Keeping your workspace clean and organized

Your new job as an Assembly Worker takes place in a day shift, Monday to Friday, from 06:00 am to 15:00 pm. Leaving your weekends free!

- Living in Zevenhuizen, Rotterdam, The Hague, Leiden, Alphen aan den Rijn, Gouda, Zoetermeer, or surrounding areas

- Available to work a day shift from 06:00 am to 15:00 pm
- Experience using hand tools or hobby experience in making furniture
- Good command of Dutch or English

You will ensure the printing process runs smoothly, from loading paper rolls to performing maintenance. You will oversee the entire process from start to finish, making you responsible for the final product!

What will you do?

- Prepare and manage paper supply
- Manage paper and ink inventory
- Set up and operate the printing machine
- Oversee the printing process, including post-production
- Perform general maintenance
- Develop and maintain the production schedule

- You speak either Dutch or English fluently
- You live near Etten-Leur (within a 30 km radius)
- You are eager to learn and have a proactive attitude
- You have your own transportation

Do you have experience as a supervisor? Are you looking for a responsible job? Are you able to optimize day-to-day activities while minimizing costs? Then we are looking for you!

What are you going to do?
- Organize workflow by assigning responsibilities and preparing schedules
- Responsible for scheduling control
- Maintain material control and quality control
- Responsible for other duties on assembly line
- Oversee and coach employees
- Identify issues in efficiency and suggest improvements
- Enforce strict safety guidelines and company standards.

What do we offer?
In addition to a competitive and negotiable salary, we offer:

- weekly payment of this salary,
- 8% holiday allowance and 25 days of leave (on a full-time basis),
- participation in the pension scheme from day 1, and
- personal development. During your contract you have access to the Adecco Academy, an online platform with various training and courses.

Where will you work?
Our client is an employer that offers equal opportunities for everyone and embraces diversity in the employee population. Our client is a world leader in IT products. The servers are built in Den Bosch, where they have their own production department.

You often work together with (international) colleagues. They communicate with each other in English or Dutch.

- Ability to comprehend spoken and written English
- Ability to work overtime and weekends depending on business demands.

In Dordrecht, we are located at Burgemeester van der Dussenstraat 910. Here, we work with our Central Hub Manager Rob and approximately 200 colleagues. As a logistics employee at DHL, you help sort packages. You ensure that every package ends up in the right place. Without your help, the packages would not be sorted on time and would not be delivered to the customer on time.

You can start as a ‘packer’, where you place the packages on the conveyor belt so they can be sorted. You can start as a ‘packer’, where you take sorted packages off the conveyor belt and place them in a cart. Later, at DHL, you can also learn and perform other tasks in the warehouse.

Please note: a package can weigh a maximum of 25 kilos. Not every package is that heavy, but it can happen. You must always lift heavier packages together with a colleague.

Working hours/shifts vary between 17:00 and 02:00.

- You are available for at least 4 days a week between 17:00 and 02:00;
- You can lift packages weighing up to a maximum of 25 kilos;
- You have your own transport (car, bicycle, scooter, or you live within walking distance);
- You speak Dutch or English so that you can communicate well with your team.
